                    /* gently squirming rather than one clean wave against*/
                    /* otherwise-static rays. Ray thickness also varies*/
                    /* per-ray (a third, independently-seeded hash) so*/
                    /* rays don't read as uniform bars. Rendered via*/

                    /* per-ray varying width/length lines with round caps*/
                    /* are far simpler to draw imperatively than to*/
